selection_process: HAL will select apprentices on a 100% merit basis using aggregate marks obtained in the relevant qualifying degree or diploma examination.

Scrutiny of online applications and prescribed eligibility conditions. Preparation of merit lists based on 100% weightage of aggregate qualifying examination marks. Publication of the provisional selection list on the HAL Careers website. Verification of original documents of provisionally selected candidates. Submission of medical fitness and police verification certificates before joining.
The notification does not prescribe a separate written examination or interview for merit preparation.
The provisional selection list is scheduled to be published between 30 November and 2 December 2026 in the Careers section of the official HAL website.
The selected candidates must attend original document verification at HAL Korwa between 3 and 9 December 2026
how_to_apply: Visit the official HAL website at hal-india.co.in.
Open the Careers section and locate the Graduate and Diploma Apprentices 2026-27 advertisement for HAL Avionics Division, Korwa.
Read the educational qualification, age limit and eligibility restrictions carefully.
Visit nats.education.gov.in and complete NATS registration to obtain the registration number.
Open the official Google Application Form provided in the advertisement.
Enter the personal details, apprenticeship category, educational qualifications, aggregate marks and NATS registration number requested in the form.
Provide any additional details and supporting documents required by the Google Form.
Dependents of serving, retired or deceased HAL employees claiming the applicable consideration must attach the prescribed employee details certified by the concerned HAL HR Officer.
Submit the Google Application Form by 13 November 2026.
Check the HAL Careers website for the provisional selection list and verification schedule.
Important: Incomplete or incorrectly filled applications may be rejected. Applications submitted through email, post or any mode other than the prescribed Google Form will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: HAL Korwa Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a recognized degree or diploma in one of the notified disciplines and satisfy the age, qualification age, previous apprenticeship and work-experience conditions. Applicants must possess a four-year B.E. or B.Tech. degree from a recognized university or institution in the relevant engineering branch. Candidates must have completed a three-year Engineering Diploma in one of the specified branches from a recognized board or university. Candidates who have completed, resigned from, terminated or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training at any organization, or are registered under the Apprentices Act. Candidates whose degree or diploma will have completed five years since passing as on 15 February 2027 . Candidates with one year or more of work experience in any organization. Candidates who completed a technical or general degree/diploma through correspondence mode. Important: The five-year restriction is calculated using 15 February 2027, not the online application closing date. Candidates should verify their qualification passing date before applying.

content_sections.heading: HAL Korwa Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: HAL will select apprentices on a 100% merit basis using aggregate marks obtained in the relevant qualifying degree or diploma examination . Scrutiny of online applications and prescribed eligibility conditions. Preparation of merit lists based on 100% weightage of aggregate qualifying examination marks. Publication of the provisional selection list on the HAL Careers website. Verification of original documents of provisionally selected candidates. Submission of medical fitness and police verification certificates before joining. The notification does not prescribe a separate written examination or interview for merit preparation. The provisional selection list is scheduled to be published between 30 November and 2 December 2026 in the Careers section of the official HAL website. The selected candidates must attend original document verification at HAL Korwa between 3 and 9 December 2026 , according to the notified schedule.

content_sections.heading: HAL Korwa Apprentice Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must register through the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal and submit their applications using the Google Form specified in the HAL notification. content_sections.text: Important: Incomplete or incorrectly filled applications may be rejected. Applications submitted through email, post or any mode other than the prescribed Google Form will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for HAL Korwa Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Provisionally selected candidates must produce the original documents and self-attested copies during verification, along with one recent passport-size photograph. Provisionally selected candidates must submit the following certificates at the time of joining apprenticeship training: Medical Fitness Certificate: Issued by a Government Medical Officer not below the rank of Assistant Surgeon (Gazetted). Police Verification Certificate: Obtained from the Commissioner or Superintendent of Police of the candidate's place of residence. Original documents must be produced during verification and at joining as required by HAL. OBC candidates must produce a valid Non-Creamy Layer certificate in the prescribed Central Government format, issued within six months of the application closing date.

content_sections.heading: HAL Korwa Apprentice Training Duration 2026
content_sections.text: The apprenticeship training period is one year under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Selected candidates will be required to execute an apprenticeship training contract. After completion of training, the apprenticeship contract will close. HAL has no obligation to offer temporary or permanent employment to candidates who complete the training.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), Avionics Division, Korwa, Amethi, Uttar Pradesh for engaging apprentices under the Apprentices Act 1961.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in HAL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts include Engineering Graduate Apprentice, Non-Engineering Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, and Technician (Non-Technical Diploma Apprentice) across various professional streams.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt and submission of the complete application through the Google Application Form is 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 26 years as on 13-11-2026, with permissible relaxations for OBC, SC, ST, and PWD categories as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Engineering Graduates?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a 4-year B.Tech or B.E. degree from a recognized Board or University in relevant engineering branches including Electronics, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, or Computer Science.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification released by Hindustan Aeronautics Limited for these apprentice positions.

faq.question: Q7. How is the selection of candidates determined?
faq.answer: Selection is completely merit-based, considering 100% weightage of the total aggregate marks secured in the qualifying examination, followed by document verification and medical examination.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the apprenticeship training?
faq.answer: The apprenticeship training period is strictly for one year only, and successful completion does not guarantee regular employment with HAL.

faq.question: Q9. How can eligible candidates apply for the posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must first register on the NATS portal (www.nats.education.gov.in) to obtain a registration number and then fill out the Google Application Form provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the document verification take place for selected candidates?
faq.answer: The verification of original documents for provisionally selected candidates is scheduled to take place at HAL Korwa on 03 December 2026.
